reaction: Its contrasting role with insulin is clear.
reason: I'll use the only gameplay option to signal the liver to release its stored glucose.
expectation: I expect the liver to break apart some stored carbohydrate and release glucose into the blood.

effect: The liver released glucose into the blood, completing the between-meal route. The release signal eases as blood glucose rises.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the stored granules become separate glucose molecules again.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose into liver storage and then back into the blood made the between-meal fuel supply understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing each pancreatic message was fairly predictable from the labels, though it helped connect the two scenes.

surprise.text: The picture showed insulin staying outside muscle cells while glucose became stored granules; the message was not the building material.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The last two actions were the only gameplay options, but their purpose was explained by the between-meal goal.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the liver release stored glucose made me curious how the body manages fuel in other situations, although the final choices were predictable.
